bodyMarkdown:
**Last updated:** 03 November 2026

Fun App Ltd respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data.

This Privacy Notice explains how Fun App Ltd ("the Company") collects, stores, uses, discloses and protects your personal data when you visit its website (https://funapp.world/), join its mailing list or waitlist, register a business or venue interest, purchase a pre-launch package or service or register for and use the Fun App mobile application (collectively, "the Service").

Fun App is designed and developed to help people build friendships, discover group activities and form introductions.

1. **ABOUT FUN APP LTD**

Fun App Ltd is the data controller responsible for the personal data processed in connection with its website, waitlist, mobile application, venue partner tools, enquiries and services.

* **Company:** Fun App Ltd (Company number: 17261344)
* **Registered office:** 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, United Kingdom, W1W 5PF
* **Privacy Contact Email:** info@funapp.world

If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or how the Company processes your personal data, please contact the Privacy Contact above.

1. **WHAT PERSONAL DATA DOES THE COMPANY COLLECT?**

The Company collects personal data directly from you, automatically through your device and from verified third-party partners.

**A) Data Collected via the Website and Pre-Launch Services**

* **Waitlist and Enquiries:** First name, last name, email address, country or region and market research responses regarding intended app usage.
* **Business, Venue, Club, Charity and Partner Enquiries:** Organisation name and type, structure, site capacity, website address, contact person full name, role or job title, professional email address and contact telephone number.
* **Direct Purchases:** Name, email address, transaction reference and purchase confirmation details when purchasing the Founding Friend package.

 B) **Data Collected via Mobile Application Consumer Accounts**

To provide matchmaking, social connections, group activities and real-world event features, the Company processes:

* **Registration and Profile Data:** Name, age, date of birth, gender identity, relationship status, bio descriptions, social interests, preferences and profile photographs.
* **Mandatory Identity and Age Verification Data:** Government-issued photo identification documents (such as passports or driving licences) and facial image/liveness scan data processed to verify that you are at least 18 years old and to confirm your authentic identity. Identity and age verification checks are provided via a third-party partner, **Didit**, acting as a data processor on behalf of the Company. While raw copies of your identity documents or facial scans are not stored directly on the Company’s core application servers, Didit securely hosts and stores this verification data, and verification results and records remain accessible to the Company through Didit for safety, compliance and verification auditing purposes.
* **Communications and User Content:** Content of private messages, group chat conversations, activity post listings, event host notes, profile photographs and user safety reports.
* **Location Data:** Precise or coarse real-time geographic location derived from your mobile device GPS or IP address, used to display nearby group activities, recommend local matches and locate Partner Venues.
* **Technical and Usage Data:** IP address, unique device identifiers (IDFA/GAID), device hardware model, operating system version, push notification tokens, log-in timestamps, feature usage interactions and crash reports.

**C) Data Collected via Venue Partner and Business Accounts**

The Company provides dedicated accounts for venues, clubs, businesses and partner organisations ("Venue Partners") allowing the Partner to manage its venue profile, list group activities and interact with the platform commercially.

* **Venue Partner Representative - Contact Data:** Partner representative's full name, job title or role, professional email address and contact telephone number (matching the venue sign-up form fields).
* **Venue Profile and Commercial Offer Data:** Venue name, trading style/DBA, physical address, venue capacity, operating hours, category/type (e.g. bar, club, activity centre), website URL, venue imagery/promotional assets and specific offers, discounts and perks extended to Fun App users.
* **Venue Account Credentials and Technical Data:** B2B account login credentials (username/password hashes), security access logs and administrative permissions.
* **Separation of Accounts:** Venue Partner accounts are maintained entirely separately from consumer user accounts. Venue Partner accounts are used exclusively for commercial venue profile management, group activity hosting and perk administration. Venue representatives are not subject to consumer dating matchmaking features or consumer identity verification workflows through these professional accounts.

**D) Special Category Personal Data and Biometric Processing**

Because Fun App facilitates social and dating introductions, consumers may choose to provide data that reveals information regarding their sexual orientation, religious beliefs or political opinions within their profile or chat communications.

Furthermore, completing mandatory consumer identity verification requires processing facial image liveness data, which is classified as **Biometric Data (Special Category Personal Data)** under UK GDPR. Age and identity verification checks are carried out on behalf of the Company by its designated third-party verification processor, **Didit.** Didit securely hosts biometric data and ID documentation on behalf of the Company, and the Company accesses verification records through Didit strictly on the basis of explicit consent and substantial public interest grounds (preventing impersonation, under-age access, fraud and severe harms).

1. **HOW DOES THE COMPANY USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA?**

The Company processes your personal data for the following key purposes:

1. **Service Provision and Matchmaking:** Operating the mobile app, managing user accounts, facilitating direct connections, hosting group activities, displaying partner venue promotions and delivering the Here & Now membership tier.
2. **Venue Partner Management:** Administering B2B venue accounts, displaying and moderating venue profiles, member offers, discounts, and perks and coordinating group activity meetups at partner locations.
3. **Safety, Moderation and Verification:** Enforcing strict 18+ eligibility, conducting mandatory identity checks via **Didit**, monitoring compliance with the Acceptable Use Policy, investigating user reports and moderating public and private content.
4. **Location-Based Features:** Displaying nearby users, group meetups and commercial Partner Venues offering member benefits.
5. **Payment Processing and Administration:** Processing web and in-app purchases, managing active subscriptions, administering the Founding Friend resale facility and retaining statutory transaction records.
6. **Marketing and Communications:** Sending service announcements, trust and safety updates, app launch news and marketing emails (where required consent is provided).
7. **Platform Development and Analytics:** Conducting market research, analysing app stability, testing new features and enhancing safety safeguards.
8. **Legal Compliance and Harm Prevention:** Cooperating with law enforcement agencies in England and Wales, handling emergency disclosure requests, preventing criminal acts and fulfilling statutory accounting and tax obligations.

  4. **LAWFUL BASIS FOR PROCESSING UNDER UK GDPR**

Under the UK GDPR, the Company must rely on valid lawful basis to process personal data:

* **Performance of a Contract:** Processing required to fulfil the User Agreement, Website Terms of Use, Founding Friend T\&Cs or commercial Venue Partner terms (e.g., account creation, delivering digital services, processing payments or managing venue accounts).
* **Consent:** For sending direct marketing emails, accessing precise real-time device location and processing Special Category / Biometric Data via **Didit** for identity verification. Consent may be withdrawn at any time.
* **Legitimate Interests:** Operating, securing and improving the Service; managing prospective and active venue partnerships; storing venue enquiries and information within **HubSpot**; conducting market research; and protecting platform security, provided such interests are not overridden by individual privacy rights.
* **Legal Obligations:** Retaining tax and accounting records, verifying legal age, responding to valid legal process or fulfilling regulatory obligations.
* **Vital Interests, Legal Obligations and Public/Legitimate Interests:** Disclosing data to emergency services where there is an immediate, exigent threat to life or physical safety (relying on vital interests) or cooperating with law enforcement authorities in England and Wales to support investigations of crime, exploitation, or serious harm pursuant to legal obligations, public interest or legitimate safety interests.

1. **PURCHASES AND PAYMENTS**

* **Website Payments:** Payments for website offerings (such as the £249 Founding Friend package) are processed through **Stripe**. The Company does not store full payment card details or credentials. Stripe processes payment and transaction data as an independent controller in accordance with its own privacy statement.
* **In-App Purchases and Subscriptions:** Standard mobile app subscriptions (e.g., Here & Now monthly memberships) are billed directly through the **Apple App Store** (Apple Inc.) or **Google Play Store** (Google LLC). Financial credentials are held exclusively by the respective app store provider; the Company receives only transaction confirmation tokens and subscription validity status.

1. **DATA SHARING AND THIRD-PARTY PROCESSORS**

The Company shares personal data only with trusted third-party service providers acting as data processors or independent controllers where necessary to operate the Service, including:

* **Identity Verification Provider:** **Didit**, acting as a data processor to process government photo ID documents and conduct biometric liveness checks to enforce 18+ eligibility and identity verification. Didit securely stores verification images and data on behalf of the Company, which the Company accesses via Didit for safety and verification auditing.
* **CRM and Venue Management Infrastructure:** **HubSpot**, used to store, manage and process contact information, waitlists, venue enquiries and ongoing Venue Partner account records.
* **Infrastructure and Cloud Providers:** Cloud hosting services and push notification services supporting application infrastructure.
* **Payment Processors:** Stripe, Apple Inc. and Google LLC for financial processing and billing administration.
* **Partner Venues and Member Perks:** Aggregate, non-identifiable demographic reports are shared with commercial partner venues. Individual personal data is only shared with venues when a user explicitly redeems a venue perk/offer or registers for a specific venue-hosted event.
* **Law Enforcement and Regulatory Bodies:** As detailed in the Law-Enforcement Referral Policy, data may be disclosed to police forces in England and Wales or statutory regulators when required by law, court order or in response to an emergency threat to physical safety or cooperating with law enforcement authorities in England and Wales to support investigations of crime, exploitation, or serious harm pursuant to legal obligations, public interest or legitimate safety interests.

The Company does not sell personal data.

 7. **INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS**

Where service providers transfer personal data outside the United Kingdom, the Company ensures appropriate legal safeguards are implemented under UK data protection law (such as UK Adequacy Decisions, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) or the UK Addendum to EU Standard Contractual Clauses).

1. **DATA RETENTION AND ACCOUNT DELETION**

The Company retains personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this Privacy Notice:

* **Waitlist and Marketing Data:** Retained while you remain subscribed or as long as reasonably necessary for product development. If you unsubscribe, your details are removed from active marketing lists.
* **Active Consumer Accounts and Account Deletion:** Profile details, chat messages and activity data remain active while your account is open. When you delete your account via in-app settings, your public profile and active account data are removed from public view and discovery within 30 days. However, the Company retains certain transactional data, safety enforcement logs, messaging metadata and investigation records for a longer period where necessary to comply with legal obligations, prevent fraud, enforce permanent safety bans or support law enforcement investigations into illegal acts or serious harms under UK law.
* **Venue Partner Accounts:** Information relating to Venue Partner enquiries, account records and venue profile data is retained for as long as necessary to manage the commercial relationship and for a reasonable statutory period following account termination to maintain business records.
* **Identity and Verification Data:** Identity document images and facial biometric scan data are securely hosted by **Didit** on behalf of the Company in accordance with configured security and retention parameters. The Company accesses these verification records via Didit for as long as an account remains active or as required to prevent fraud, enforce safety bans and meet statutory audit standards.
* **Statutory and Safety Records:** Transaction records, safety enforcement logs and legal preservation records are retained for statutory periods required for accounting, tax, legal and regulatory purposes.

1. **APP PERMISSIONS AND LOCATION CONTROLS**

The mobile app relies on specific device permissions to function correctly:

* **Location Services:** You can grant or revoke location access at any time through your mobile device (iOS/Android) system settings. Disabling location services may limit location-based matching and nearby activity discovery.
* **Camera and Photo Library:** Used solely when you choose to upload profile pictures, scan identity documents or participate in verification checks via **Didit**.
* **Push Notifications:** Used to deliver match alerts, event updates and safety notices. You may toggle notifications in your device settings.

1. **COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES**

The Website does not currently use non-essential analytics or advertising tracking cookies. It uses only strictly necessary cookies required for fundamental website operations and security. If non-essential cookies are introduced in the future, an appropriate consent banner and cookie policy will be implemented.

1. **YOUR DATA PROTECTION RIGHTS**

Depending on the circumstances, you have rights under UK data protection law including:

* the right to ask for a copy of the personal data the Company holds about you;
* the right to ask the Company to correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data;
* the right to ask the Company to erase your personal data in certain circumstances;
* the right to ask the Company to restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances;
* the right to object to certain processing;
* the right to withdraw consent where the Company relies on consent as its lawful basis; and
* in certain circumstances, the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

You also have an absolute right to object to the processing of your personal data for direct marketing purposes.

1. **HOW TO EXERCISE YOUR RIGHTS**

You can exercise your rights or ask questions about how the Company processes your personal data by contacting:

**Email:** info@funapp.world

You can also unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time by using the unsubscribe link included in the relevant email. The Company may request additional information to verify your identity before responding to a data protection request.

1. **COMPLAINTS**

The Company hopes that it can resolve any question or concern you have about its use of your personal data. You also have the right to complain to the UK's data protection regulator, the **Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO)** (https://ico.org.uk/).

1. **CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY NOTICE**

The Company will update this Privacy Notice from time to time to reflect changes to the website, mobile app, venue portal, services, data-processing activities or applicable law. If material changes are made, reasonable steps will be taken to bring those changes to your attention.

1. **CONTACT THE COMPANY**

If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or the Company’s use of your personal data, please contact:

Fun App Ltd

167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, United Kingdom, W1W 5PF

Company number: 17261344

Email: info@funapp.world
